scientific_integrity: The finite Gram computations and high-precision asymptotic examples are supplementary to a self-contained analytic argument; no claim of independent validation or publication priority is made.
scientific_limitations: The exact negative eigenvalue and its scaling concern the compact auxiliary defect I-B*B for order-one generalized Cesaro matrices with negative shifts. The original self-commutator is shown to have negative index one, but its eigenvalue magnitude is not identified. Potentially broader classical rank-one weak-binding results can affect publication priority.
title: Exponentially weak positivity loss in shifted Cesàro interrupters
